name: human-phenotype-docker
description: Monorepo root for HPO TypeScript packages (Turborepo)

scripts.publish: npm run build && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-lib && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-express && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-api
scripts.publish:dry: npm run build && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-lib --dry-run && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-express --dry-run && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-api --dry-run
